newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Karawaci half-year 1996 net up 112 pct.
newsitem.headline: Karawaci half-year 1996 net up 112 pct.

text.p: Indonesian property developer PT Lippo Karawaci, the real estate arm of the Lippo Group, announced on Monday that it posted a net profit of 41 billion rupiah in the six months ended December 31, 1996.

"Lippo Karawaci, with a continued focus on the middle income market, has succesfully launched new products which are tailored to meet this market's needs. As a result, profits surged 112 percent to 41 billion rupiah," it said in an advertisement in Bisnis Indonesia newspaper.
"At the same time, the price earnings ratio was very attractive at 8.7 times as of February 21, 1997".
The company said its earnings per share was 108 rupiah and total equity was 495 billion rupiah.
In afternoon trade, Lippo Karawaci rose 225 rupiah to 3,775 rupiah on a volume of 4.2 million shares. Brokers said the earnings result had triggered interest in the counter.
Lippo Karawaci was listed in June 1996.
